privacy.label: Legal
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy informs you about the nature, scope and purpose of the processing of personal data on this website.
privacy.controllerText: The data controller within the meaning of the GDPR is:
privacy.hostingText: This website is self-hosted. When you access this website, your browser automatically sends certain data (e.g., IP address, date and time of the request, requested page) to our server. This data is only processed to ensure the stable operation of the website and is deleted after 7 days. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in the secure operation of the website).
privacy.analyticsText: We use Umami, a self-hosted, privacy-focused web analytics tool, to understand how our website is used. Umami does not use cookies and does not collect any personal data. All data is aggregated and no individual visitors can be identified. The analytics service is hosted on our own infrastructure at analytics.reforgelabs.com. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in improving our website).
privacy.localStorageText: This website uses the browser's local storage to save your theme preference (light/dark mode). This data is stored exclusively in your browser and is never transmitted to our server. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in providing a personalized user experience).
privacy.fontsText: This website uses self-hosted fonts (Inter, Crimson Pro). No connections to external font services are established. No data is transmitted to third parties.
privacy.externalLinksText: This website contains links to external websites (LinkedIn, GitHub, X, ORCID, HuggingFace, Bluesky). When you click on these links, you will be redirected to the respective external website. We have no control over the content and privacy practices of these websites. Please refer to the privacy policies of the respective providers.
privacy.contactText: If you contact us by email, your data (email address, name, message content) will be stored for the purpose of processing and responding to your inquiry. This data will not be shared with third parties. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in responding to inquiries) or Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR if the inquiry is related to a contract.
privacy.rightsText: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.rightRestriction: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
privacy.complaintText: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. The competent supervisory authority is:
privacy.supervisory: The Hamburg Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (HmbBfDI), Ludwig-Erhard-Str. 22, 20459 Hamburg
privacy.changesText: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy to reflect changes in our data processing practices or legal requirements. The current version is always available on this page.
about.label: About
about.title: About Me
about.textIntro: Jonas Wilinski is an ML engineer and PhD candidate at the Hamburg University of Technology (TUHH). He trains NLP models and builds the data systems they need, and uses them to study how AI concepts spread through science. Before the PhD he worked as CTO of the supply chain start-up Cargofaces, in digitalization at Porsche AG, and as a freelance IT consultant; the details are on his
about.textMid: . He holds an M.Sc. in International Industrial Engineering from TU Hamburg and a B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering & IT from Kiel University. His
about.textEnd: include work at EMNLP and DRUID. His stack spans Python, PyTorch, SQL and DuckDB, Docker, React and Swift.

hobbies.title: Hobbies
hobbies.tagline: Sailing, mostly. And a camera wherever I go.
hobbies.description: Most of my free time I spend on or near the water. I sail whenever I can, bring a camera and a drone along, and edit the footage into short films afterwards. These are the trips I have made films of so far, from the Arctic to the South Island of New Zealand, plus some surfing, cycling and skiing closer to home.
privacy.youtubeText: The hobbies page shows videos hosted on YouTube. Until you click a video, only a preview image stored on this server is shown and no connection to YouTube is made. When you click play, the video is loaded from youtube-nocookie.com, a domain operated by Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland. Your IP address and technical information about your browser are then transmitted to Google. The legal basis is your consent by clicking (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
